title: Margarita
summary: A crisp tequila cocktail built around fresh lime, orange liqueur, and balance.
ingredients: 1/2 oz agave syrup or simple syrup
steps: Add tequila, lime juice, orange liqueur, and syrup to a shaker.
Strain into a rocks glass over fresh ice.
notes: Fresh lime is essential. Adjust sweetness depending on the tequila and orange liqueur.
